data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD 2D game FX sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF chroma-key background, arranged as exactly 2 rows by 2 columns with four equal frames. No guide lines, no borders, no labels, no safe-area marks, no separators visible. Each animation frame is centered in its cell, consistently scaled, and contained within the central 65% of that cell so nothing crosses cell edges.

Effect: a universal special-card trigger effect, an elegant arcane sunburst that resembles a chrysanthemum of thin magical light beams.

Frame 1 (top-left): a small golden magical point at center with a faint circular trace, subtle and minimal.
Frame 2 (top-right): symmetrical slender sun rays unfurling from the center like delicate flower petals, luminous gold-white with refined magical glow.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): a bright, refined sunburst with a thin rune-like circular halo around it; the halo should feel magical and engraved but contain no readable letters or symbols.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): the sun rays fade into tiny gold-white motes and a dim halo, softer and dissipating.

Visual style: fantasy card-game special effect, crisp readable silhouette at small size, elegant, luminous, gold and white highlights with subtle warm amber tones, soft bloom but controlled edges, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons, no playing card. Keep each frame isolated and centered within its own quadrant, with clear magenta background filling all unused space.
